newsitem.title: KENYA: Prices seen mixed at Kenyan tea auction.
newsitem.headline: Prices seen mixed at Kenyan tea auction.

text.p: Tea prices were mixed at the Kenyan export auction in Mombasa on Monday, traders said.
Brighter BP1s appreciated by 3-7 U.S. cents and sometimes more, mediums were about firm while lower mediums and plainer sorts shed up to three cents. Brighter PF1s gained 2-5 cents.

Brighter PDUSTs were about firm while coloury mediums appreciated by up to three cents. Lower mediums and plainer PDUSTs opened firm but closed a little easier. Brighter DUST1s although irregular, generally advanced by 3-6 cents.
Fannings gained value. BMFs appreciated by up to 10 cents.
Pakistan and Egypt were the main buyers.
